    <bpmn:task id="informReject" name="Inform claimant that claim must be rejected" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="rejectEnd" name="Claim rejected" />
    <bpmn:task id="evaluateSeverity" name="Evaluate severity of claim" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="complexGw" name="Simple or complex claim?" />
    <bpmn:task id="sendSimple" name="Send forms for simple claim" />
    <bpmn:task id="sendComplex" name="Send forms for complex claim" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="informReject" targetRef="rejectEnd" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="evaluateSeverity" targetRef="complexGw" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="checkForms" targetRef="completeGw" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" name="Yes" sourceRef="completeGw" targetRef="register" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f15" name="No" sourceRef="completeGw" targetRef="informUpdate" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f17" sourceRef="informUpdate" targetRef="updateForms" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f18" sourceRef="updateForms" targetRef="checkForms" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
